Frontend Development

Become a World-Class Frontend Developer

Bring designs to life through code by turning them into responsive, interactive websites and apps.

Enrol Now
Apply For Scholarship

Beginner Friendly

No prior experience required.

Job Placement Support

Launch your career with internships and job placements.

Flexible Learning

Choose to learn at a pace that fits your schedule.

World-Class Tutors & Mentorship

Learn directly from industry experts.

Certificate

Earn a recognised certificate.

Download Course Brochure & Curriculum

Course Overview

The Frontend Development course is designed to teach students how to build beautiful, responsive, and user-friendly websites and web applications.

You’ll learn how to turn ideas and designs into functional digital experiences using modern web technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React.

This hands-on course takes you from beginner to job-ready, combining technical mastery with design thinking and real-world project experience — preparing you for a career in web and interface development.

Learning Outcome

  1. Build responsive, accessible websites using HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
  2. Use frameworks and libraries such as React.js to create dynamic, interactive web applications.
  3. Work with APIs and connect frontend apps to backend systems.
  4. Deploy and maintain production-ready websites using version control and hosting platforms.

Next Cohort Starts
October 31st 2026

Duration: 3 months
Enrol Now
Apply For Scholarship

Career Opportunities

  1. United States – $80,000 – $120,000 USD
  2. United Kingdom – £50,000 – £80,000 GBP
  3. Canada – $70,000 – $100,000 CAD
  4. Germany – €55,000 – €85,000 EUR
  5. Nigeria – ₦5.5 million – ₦9.5 million NGN
  6. Kenya – KSh 2.5 million – KSh 4.2 million KES
  7. Remote/Global Roles – $60,000 – $110,000 USD

Career Pathways

  1. Frontend Developer
  2. UI Developer
  3. Web Developer
  4. JavaScript Engineer
  5. React Developer

What You Will Learn

Go from Idea to Impact, become a Frontend Developer in 3-6 Months.

Module 1 - Introduction to the Web
  • How the Internet & Web Work
  • Frontend vs Backend Roles
Module 2 - HTML Fundamentals
  • Page Structure, Tags, and Attributes
  • Links, Lists, and Images
Module 3 - Advanced HTML & Semantic Layout
  • Forms, Tables, Multimedia
  • Semantic Elements & Accessibility
Module 4 - CSS Basics
  • Selectors, Colors, and the Box Model
  • Typography and Inheritance
Module 5 - Layout Techniques
  • Flexbox and Grid Systems
  • Responsive Layout Strategies
Module 6 - CSS Styling & Animations
  • Transitions and Keyframes
  • Custom Fonts & UI Design Principles
Module 7 - JavaScript Basics
  • Variables, Data Types, and Operators
  • Conditionals, Loops, and Functions
Module 8 - DOM Manipulation & Events
  • Selecting & Modifying Elements
  • Event Handling and Form Validation
Module 9 - ES6+ Features
  • Let and Const,
  • Arrow Functions and Destructuring
  • Template Literals & Modules
Module 10 - APIs & Asynchronous JavaScript
  • Fetch API, Promises, and Async/Await
  • Working with JSON Data
Module 11 - Career Readiness & Next Steps
  • Git Basics, Branching, and Merging
  • Collaboration on Github
  • Hosting Projects on GitHub
Module 12 - Introduction to React
  • Components, Props, and State
  • JSX and Project Setup
Module 13 - React Routing & API Integration
  • React Router
  • Fetching Data from APIs
Module 14 - Capstone Project
  • Build and Deploy a Complete Frontend Web App

70% of our graduates started with zero tech experiences. Our beginner-friendly approach starts with basics and builds progressively
I can’t afford it
Up to 50-100% scholarship coverage available. You only pay registration and certification fees upfront.
I don't have time
Flexible learning schedules including evenings and weekends. Complete the program while maintaining your current job.
Will I actually get a job?
Guaranteed internship placement + access to exclusive job board with 500+ partner companies actively hiring our graduates
